scope: Prepared local CE API/SQL comparison. Uncommitted source; no release or production capacity claim. No credentials or message bodies included.
comparison_boundary: Controlled legacy compact-window route vs typed aggregate on the same current CE ap26 dataset. Stored canonical projections already include new optional _statistics; this is not exact old-version storage-byte comparison and not evidence of columnstore-only gain. Original signoz data and nine original services are outside task mutation scope. Fixed org authentication at Go handler boundary, real Django APIs/production Go handlers/real DB; not hosted end-to-end authentication. NO_PROXY set equally on baseline/candidate.

final_five_request_concurrency.classification: Five simultaneous actual Django APIs, no browser render or retries. Final operation-page chooses at most 200 recent keys under a complete typed gate and hydrates only selected Trace batches; statistics and trend use SQL aggregates. n=3 interleaved routes; all samples retained.

individual_latency.paired_sequence: baseline,candidate,candidate,baseline,baseline,candidate; exact-final-row n3 is separate final-source smoke with same query shape, not a claim of same-time paired row measurements

row.storage_scope: Sum GV$OB_SSTABLES SIZE of both task fact tables, MDS excluded, not total disk or universal compression claim.

hybrid.storage_scope: Sum GV$OB_SSTABLES SIZE of both task fact tables, MDS excluded, not total disk or universal compression claim.

column.storage_scope: Sum GV$OB_SSTABLES SIZE of both task fact tables, MDS excluded, not total disk or universal compression claim.

layout_decision: New tables explicitly rowstore: measured read ranges overlap and row reported smaller fact SSTable size. Existing hybrid/column unchanged. No forced index or global setting.

aggregate_wire_components.classification: Direct final aggregate wire component size diagnostic; not an app latency sample. Component sizes are reserialized JSON, full HTTP bytes are exact.

projection_publication.classification: Interleaved baseline and candidate real Go batch publication over same 12 native Traces in fresh ap26write prefix, no experimental covering index. Time includes publisher+DB after db.Ping but excludes JSON decode, HTTP and Docker startup. Not a historical bulk migration throughput claim.

dynamic_attribute_filter.classification: Actual Eino dynamic attribute filter, native frozen raw rows only; same request candidate versus emergency raw mode, no fixture mutation. Value retained only in private fixture.

typed_functional_gates.classification: Reversible writes only to ap26 derived rows. Raw view and original signoz tables untouched. Controlled synthetic scalar/bounds cases alter only task projection payload and are restored by real source publication.

operation_http_gates.classification: Reversible task-only optional receipt/dirty/maintenance tests against actual final operation-page then hydration or legacy fallback. No original/raw changes.

operation_edge_gates.classification: Unmodified production Python query_framework invoked locally with actual private SQLite routing and real Go HTTP/CE SQL. Local client wrapper only routes old404 to frozen baseline, or performs one explicit ap26 source revision/dirty race between actual operation-page and hydration. This is a deterministic integration probe, not Django HTTP timing or raw ingestion. No original/raw mutation.

python.scope: Fixture-backed Django behavior tests, no real SQL/API/AP timing claim

go.scope: Offline unit tests; real CE SQL lifecycle/aggregate performance validated separately by lab. No release/deploy/commit/PR.

review.scope: Read-only source review, focused Python reproductions, final test-receipt/hash verification, and inspection of lab-emitted SQL/plan/parity receipts; reviewer made no DB or service changes and did not independently execute SQL.

cleanup.classification: Stop only task-owned Django listeners and two named task transports; retain every task table, view, proof index, source snapshot and container for reproduction. Original nine services preserved.

sampling_notes.auth_throttle: A fourth login series caused auth/login429 before any timed query started. Preserved concurrent-preauth-throttle.json and failed log. Natural throttle expiry, then one normal login with cookies reused over five independent connections completed remaining samples. No query sample discarded; no auth rule/config changed.
sampling_notes.publication: Write costs measured on exact final typed publisher/schema before read-only operation-page/generation-fence additions, in fresh ap26write with no proof index; publication implementation unchanged.

limitations: Same single local CE 4CPU/8GiB node; other OB editions, production load and larger datasets untested.
Typed publication adds measured write overhead; full history product catch-up throughput not benchmarked.
Unsupported/missing/dirty statistics and source or maintenance-generation drift intentionally fall back to complete snapshot reads; these may remain slow.
Bounded sorted latency vector is 144001 bytes for 30000 values; not an all-constant-size aggregate.
Earlier 8-query, P95 shape and literal-cursor experiments are diagnostic, excluded from final exact business-hash claims.

authentication_boundary.safe_alternative: Retained authorized connection; mutations restricted to task prefixes; original source tables read-only.
